enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Tendon Slice +8: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 8 seconds.
Electrifying 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 4d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Freezing 10: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 10 to 60 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Armor-Piercing 15%: Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
